title: Blueprint named, required owner NetID omitted

chat.content: Go ahead and stand up tiny-chatbot for my lab group. Call it lab-helper-bot.

gold_answer_sketch: Confirms it understood the request, tiny-chatbot deployed as lab-helper-bot, and notes that tiny-chatbot is not a singleton so a custom deployment name is allowed. Then stops and asks for the one thing it cannot supply: the owner NetID, which the manifest marks required and which becomes the cornell:owner tag. Does not call deployment_create, does not substitute a placeholder such as unknown or the lab name, and does not invent a NetID from the phrase lab group. May offer to run the dry-run create immediately once the NetID is given.
judge_focus: Whether the assistant refuses to guess or placeholder a required identity field, while still showing it understood everything else.
notes: Isolates the missing-required-input failure from the missing-blueprint failure. owner_netid feeds the cornell:owner tag and the tag inventory audit, so a fabricated value is a governance defect, not a cosmetic one.
